authority.source_of_truth: main source at reviewed commit; review branch carries temporary evidence only
authority.branch_policy: sequential reviewers; one writer; no PR, force push, or merges

rules.stage_sequence: X0-X7 complete as historical source audits; X8 repairs/acceptance still in progress. X9-X13 sequential read-only full-file review permitted while X8 awaits device tests. X14 blocked until all gates; X15 cleanup only after explicit approval.
rules.stage_completion: Write evidence and precise review coverage; commit stage JSON + canonical ledgers + diagrams in one atomic change; set stage status complete ONLY when gate met
rules.main_drift: Recheck main HEAD before each worker. If newer, record difference, reconcile referenced files, do not silently review stale code
rules.review_writes: All temporary review-only files on review branch; no test IPA from review-only commits
rules.code_writes: Only X8 repairs may change main after explicit case matrix, review, tests and HEAD check; never add review files to main
rules.file_review: Every queued current/excluded/historical path must receive reviewed, reviewed_limited or blocked with actual inspected source/media evidence and test oracle; queueing is never a pass.
rules.ocr: Manual OCR-style through GitHub in Chat; CLI not run unless separately installed and authorized. Never invoke paid or external OCR model by default
rules.untangle: Canonical owners, hidden links, needless links, surplus code, special-case gates and cross-domain recovery
rules.acceptance: Per implemented task >=90% measured pass weights AND all mandatory/critical cases; not_run earns zero; device not inferred from CI
rules.privacy: Public repo. No private Project Sources, typing, transcripts, audio, user text, secrets or host identifiers in review files
rules.budget: One stage per Chat. Fetch narrow slices; checkpoint current stage on limits and resume SAME stage later; never skip evidence
rules.cleanup: Only X15 after completed acceptance, durable archive and explicit user approval. No automatic deletion of review records.

scope: Build #1 through Build #236; 578 current tracked files, 14 historical-only; 426 queued from X0-X7 gaps across X9-X13. No physical iPhone test inferred.
